variable.name: Vegetation greenness
variable.definition: MODIS Enhanced Vegetation Index; an optical canopy-greenness proxy, not species identity, crop yield, disease, or animal abundance.
variable.cadence: annual growing-season mean of observed, QA-filtered composite pixels
variable.support: Actual TESViS subset grid: 33 rows x 33 columns, 231.656358264 metre posting. Site support, not administrative boundary or watershed mean.

collection_identity_evidence.limitation: Catalog identity verification is not bitwise verification of original HDF pixel contents. Unverifiable processing revisions are excluded and can cause missing annual observations.

recipe.quality: pixel reliability=0; MODLAND=0; VI usefulness<=4; no high aerosol, adjacent/mixed cloud, snow or shadow
recipe.aggregation: actual pixel observation month -> within-composite observed-pixel mean -> equal composite means within month -> equal selected-month mean; all selected months required
recipe.note: Composite observations are not daily observations. Changing accepted pixel support and sampling remain limitations.

limitations: Actual TESViS subset grid: 33 rows x 33 columns, 231.656358264 metre posting. Site support, not administrative boundary or watershed mean.
EVI is optical greenness, not tree mortality, species, yield, infection or biodiversity.
Clear-sky selection and changing accepted pixels can affect the series; the QA/coverage ledger is exported.
Equal-weight composite/month sampling is a declared descriptive aggregation, not a continuous physiological seasonal integral.
A trend does not establish its cause.
Confidence intervals and significance are nominal and assumption-dependent; they are not causal probabilities.
HAC addresses suitable short-range dependence, not sensor transitions, changing spatial coverage, long memory, nonlinear change, or every climate-series problem.
